caption: The drawing shows a central human figure standing and holding several objects, including a black cross and stalks resembling palm fronds. The person is wearing a long, vertically striped garment with a patterned black skirt section near the bottom, decorated with white curved designs and a red trim. The upper garment includes a pinkish cape that drapes over both shoulders and has black accents. The individual has a beard and mustache, and a golden halo encircles their head, with a black object (possibly a hat or crown) above it. Behind the main figure is another smaller human figure colored in brownish orangish tones, with a star-shaped halo behind its head, one hand raised in a gesture and the other holding a goblet. The background features a scalloped border filled in with beige and brown, a partial blue segment behind the larger figure's head, and a large, radiating sun with a face around the smaller figure. A pink cross is present to the right of the main person's elbow within the border. The image is outlined in black ink, with sections of color filled in with muted tones of beige, orange, brown, blue, pink, black, white, and red details.
title: St. John Nepomucene-Painted on Buffalo Hide Prior to 1800
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
